text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed bumps in the public lane west of Crawford Street and north of Harbord Street, between Harbord Street and the second lane south of Bloor Street West, west of Crawford Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in the public lane west of Crawford Street and north of Harbord Street, between Harbord Street and the second lane south of Bloor Street West, west of Crawford Street, at the locations shown in Attachment 1 to the report (April 14, 2026) from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services.
